attributes.board_name: South Dakota Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners (Occupational Therapy)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Workshops, seminars, conferences, in-service programs on OT practice (1 point per hour, certificate); presenting to health/education professionals (programs of 2+ hours, 1 point per hour, max 6); publications (6 points each); accredited college course related to OT (6 points per course).
rules.alternatives: Maintaining current NBCOT certification meets the CE requirement.
rules.audit_note: Sign a statement confirming completion at each annual renewal; present proof if the board requests it. Waiver by affidavit for illness or undue hardship.
rules.notes: Annual renewal; 12 points in a one-year period, 1 point = 1 hour of attendance. Initial licenses vary in duration and run to the next renewal date.
rules.rule_quote: To qualify for renewal of a license upon its expiration as prescribed in SDCL 36-31-11, an applicant for renewal must complete 12 continuing competency points in a one-year period in professional education activities updating competency in occupational therapy and practice.
